test_cases.name: Query current account balance (cash account)
test_cases.expected: JSON output containing balance.account_balances with amount/currency, and change_records.total_count >= 0

test_cases.name: Query balance with explicit 6-month date range
test_cases.expected: JSON output with query_range begin/end covering the last 6 months

test_cases.name: Negative: --begin without --end must fail with readable error
test_cases.expected: stderr contains '--begin and --end must be provided together', exit code 1

test_cases.name: Negative: --months abc must fail with argparse int error
test_cases.expected: argparse 'invalid int value' error, exit code 2

test_cases.name: Negative: invalid balance-type must fail with readable error
Negative: limit > 100 must fail with readable error
test_cases.expected: stderr contains '--limit must be between 1 and 100', exit code 1

test_cases.name: Negative: reversed date range must fail with readable error
test_cases.expected: stderr contains 'must be earlier than or equal to --end', exit code 1
